actual_route_catalog_axis_and_predicate: NULL; opaque toy variant tags are not actual molecular routes.
event_inclusion_and_cell_stage_controls: Separate empty measurement tables mean not obtained, not zero successes.
genotype_missingness: All unsequenced cells stay unknown; assayed target no-call is explicit unknown, never absence-as-reference.
inference_status: No founder/culture event, binomial/Poisson count law, joint error budget, power or first-arrival rule is admitted.
links: Each nonfounder cell references an existing parent in the same culture.
Each observed division matches one parent stop, two daughter births, and unique cell identities.
Sequenced sample IDs are unique and belong only to sequenced terminal cells.
Variant calls cross-link existing samples and opaque toy tags; repeated inherited copies share one origin assessment.
Source/matrix anchors and toy-rule bytes are immutable by hash, without claiming authenticated timing.

cells.meaning: Tracked identity/time segment and direct genotype/recovery state; unavailable or unknown is not reference.

cultures.meaning: Founder/background/context and shared dependence; no actual system is selected.

divisions.meaning: Independent optical division record tied to exactly two daughters; no inferred mutation-rate denominator.

origin_assignments.meaning: One assessed toy variant hypothesis, with segment/window or explicit unresolved leaf status.

synthetic_truth_only.meaning: Simulation-only history; no analogous complete origin truth is available from real survivor sequencing.

variant_calls.meaning: One explicit alternate/reference/unknown row for each assayed toy target; reads are not mutation origins.

time_values: Nonnegative exact integer/rational strings; same declared toy clock; birth<stop; no event time inferred from endpoints.
type: Practical table/field dictionary and semantic relationship specification; not a full JSON-Schema implementation.
